name: Scions of the Storm
description: The Scions of the Storm strike from the heavens, descending upon their foes with the fury of Sigmar's tempest.

abilities.name: Strike From the Heavens
abilities.effect: Friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS units can use the 'Heavens-sent' ability even if they have been deployed.

abilities.name: Thunderous Arrival
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS unit uses the 'Heavens-sent' ability, you can pick 1 enemy unit within 9" of that unit. That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal damage.
